1: For the Master, to teach the saints to live according to the Book of the Community Rule, that they may seek God with all their heart and soul, doing what is good and right before Him, as He commanded through Moses and through His servants the prophets.
And that they may love all the sons of light, each according to his lot in the counsel of God, and hate all the sons of darkness, each according to his guilt in the vengeance of God.
2: And all those who freely devote themselves to His truth shall bring all their knowledge, powers, and wealth into the Community of God, to purify their knowledge in the truth of God's precepts, and to order their powers according to His ways of perfection.
And all their wealth according to His righteous counsel, so as to walk in His presence, each man with his neighbour, united in counsel and truth.
3: When these are in Israel, the Council of the Community shall be established in truth as an eternal planting, a holy house for Israel and the foundation of the holy of holies for Aaron.
And the Council of the Community shall be held guilty of sin in order to atone for the earth, and to render the wicked their retribution.
It shall be the tested wall, the precious cornerstone, whose foundations shall neither sway nor tremble from their place.
4: And when these become members of the Community in Israel according to all these rules, they shall separate from the habitation of the men of injustice and go to the wilderness, to prepare there the way of the Lord.
As it is written, In the wilderness prepare the way of the Lord, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.

This (path) is the study of the Law which He commanded through Moses, that they may do according to all that has been revealed from age to age, and as the prophets have revealed through His holy spirit.
